description: Unit tests for the quiche QUIC simulator, including classes and functions for simulating network components, alarms, packet filtering, and traffic control.

classes.name: Counter
classes.description: A simple actor that increments its value periodically in the simulator.

classes.name: CounterPort
classes.description: A port that counts received packets and bytes, and per-destination packet counts.

classes.name: LinkSaturator
classes.description: Simulates a network link that transmits packets at a specified rate to a destination.

classes.name: PacketAcceptor
classes.description: A port that accepts and stores incoming packets.

classes.name: AlarmToggler
classes.description: An actor that toggles a QuicAlarm on and off at specified intervals.

classes.name: CounterDelegate
classes.description: A delegate that counts how many times an alarm fires.

methods.name: get_value
methods.description: Returns the current value of the counter.

methods.name: Act
methods.description: Performs the actor's scheduled action, incrementing counters or transmitting packets.

methods.name: AcceptPacket
methods.description: Accepts a packet, updating byte and packet counts.

methods.name: counter
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the associated CounterPort.

methods.name: SetTxPort
methods.description: Sets the transmission port for the LinkSaturator.

methods.name: times_set
methods.description: Returns how many times the alarm was set.

methods.name: times_cancelled
methods.description: Returns how many times the alarm was cancelled.

methods.name: OnAlarm
methods.description: Callback invoked when an alarm fires.
